profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a publicly traded software company (NYSE: CRM), founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. It is best known as a customer relationship management platform and also owns Slack, a workplace messaging product. The company reported revenue of approximately $41.525 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, according to its most recent 10-K filing.

On the AI side, Salesforce offers several embedded AI products. Slack AI is built directly into the Slack messaging platform and, according to the company's own site, provides features such as channel and thread summarization, daily recaps, AI-powered search, meeting note-taking, inline message translation, and workflow automation. A personal AI agent called Slackbot is described as understanding a user's workspace, tone, and voice to help with tasks such as meeting preparation, report analysis, and project briefs. The company states that customer data is not used to train the underlying large language models, and that those models are hosted within Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. Slack also serves as the conversational interface for Agentforce, Salesforce's broader CRM-embedded AI and agent platform, while Tableau AI, marketed under the Einstein brand, brings natural language querying and AI capabilities to Salesforce's business intelligence product.

The held facts indicate that Salesforce has 181 legal matters associated with California, though no specific case details are recorded. The company also has a presence in the Model Context Protocol registry through several third-party MCP servers that enable SOQL querying, Salesforce administration, and DevOps pipeline management against Salesforce organizations.
